title: If I die
author: Mrinmoy Kumar Nath
text:
If I die
In the service of
Mother Land
And the hearts of my countrymen
Are filled with
Fire of revolution
I will not regret for my death.
When I die
If the coward people
Of my country
Become courageous
I will accept my death
With a smile in my face.
But if the fire of anger
Of my fellow people
Subside with in their heart
Burning them self
And the cowards run away with fear
Seeing my death,
My beloved country men
I never want
Such a death.
